scope: All 23 preserved Flashback photos and team marks in quarantine-manifest.json. Read-only app and asset review.
expectedResult: Every preserved asset has an identity hash, source status, creator status and permission status. Only exact hash matches are described as byte-identical. Unknowns remain explicit.

assets.gitIntroductionNote:
Use each International's own art on Flashback

Who-won prompts get that year's TI mark or stage, not the Aegis
and not the winning team.
assets.reusePermission: License grant found; attribution and license conditions must be met before reuse.
limits: This is the TI4 KeyArena photo, not a TI2 or TI3 venue photo. The previous app uses listed in the quarantine manifest could imply the wrong event.
Exact local byte identity against the Commons thumbnail could not be tested because its host returned HTTP 403.
The first candidate, Crowd_at_TI4.jpg / Flickr 14515407230, was rejected because it shows a different camera angle. Its license was not used as proof for this asset.
assets.recommendedDisposition: Keep outside public output. Do not restore on the strength of a fact-source citation.
